info.title: DiceLand Agent Adventure API
info.description: Shared-rule, editor-backed full adventure: menu difficulties, map/economy/events/dungeons, battles, terminal settlement, isolated earned progression and next runs; playable save/load, atomic profile recovery and timestamped isolated replay. One session per host; engine required. health/catalog and battle DTOs are documented in openapi.json. See AGENT_GUIDE.md for the command loop and retry rules.

200.description: Command result; check success before reading state.

400.description: Invalid command or malformed HTTP input; check success, error and message when present.

500.description: Execution/storage fault; observe/export/close, then recover the last committed state.

413.description: HTTP request body exceeds 64 KiB or lacks Content-Length.

503.description: Service stopped before processing the queued request.

post.summary: Create, observe, play, settle, save, recover or verify an adventure
post.description: One active battle or adventure per host. run_load/run_recover/run_verify require no active session. run_close releases the session/profile lease without abandoning or awarding points. Successful mutations atomically commit persistent progression plus journal before acknowledging.

choiceIndex.description: Copy the offered index; run_set_ability uses 0 (disable) or 1 (enable). run_equip needs only the offered weapon assetId; the formal service selects its compatible member.

op.description: Choose a legalActions entry for gameplay mutations. Lifecycle/storage commands are not listed in legalActions. run_next optionally accepts seed/difficultyId. All mutations use the outer adventure revision.

battleAction.description: Copy the nested battleAction exactly from an offered run_battle action. Do not attach an inner session/revision/requestId; the outer adventure owns sequencing.

requestId.description: Required unique ID for gameplay mutations. Persist the complete request before sending; a lost response must be retried with identical parameters. After load/recover only sessionId changes. Last 32 successful responses are cached; older duplicate IDs are rejected, never executed again. Lifecycle/storage calls do not consume revision/requestId.

revision.description: Latest outer adventure revision, required for mutations.

seed.description: Signed 32-bit seed for create_run or run_next; next-run omission uses default 1. maxRounds is retained from the initial create_run.

assetId.description: Asset GUID from legalActions: blueprint for crafting, weapon for equipment, material for reforge_first/second, or attribute for reforge_attribute. Ability commands use the node id in meta.nodes, not an asset GUID.

profileId.description: create_run: omit/blank for disposable progression; explicit isolated project-local profile survives close and enables run_recover. run_recover: required existing profile. IDs: 1-64 ASCII letters/digits/underscore/hyphen, Windows device names rejected. Never reads the player wallet/save. Library deletion removes these test profiles. Creating a fresh run in an existing profile replaces its recoverable adventure.

slotId.description: Required for run_save/run_load/run_export/run_verify. Same restricted ID format as profileId. Host-local name, never an arbitrary path. Saves and exported replay journals use separate directories.

difficultyId.description: Optional saved-menu GUID from catalog.catalogue.difficulties for create_run or run_next only. Omitted create_run defaults to NormalConfig (display name Medium); omitted run_next retains the current mode. Restore retains recorded difficulty.

op.description: Gameplay mutation offered in the current state. Copy its full fields and add outer sessionId/revision/requestId. run_next may additionally select seed/difficultyId.

assetId.description: Asset GUID from legalActions: blueprint for crafting, weapon for equipment, material for reforge_first/second, or attribute for reforge_attribute. Ability commands use the node id in meta.nodes, not an asset GUID.

phase.description: Active phases as listed. Empty string is serialized for an inactive/default nested DTO; check the outer response and current adventure phase.

configurationIssues.description: Authored content errors reported without substituting encounters or inventing rewards.

craftingCost.description: Current formal forge money cost, including active calamities, available in all phases even with no owned blueprint. Catalog blueprintDetails gives unowned material requirements. This observation is not permission to craft; use current legalActions.

difficultyId.description: Actual selected saved-menu difficulty GUID; difficulty is its display name.

AgentAdventureObservation.description: Observe without advancing rules or RNG. Optional nested DTOs may serialize with empty/default fields; use phase plus dungeon.active / settlement.completed, not object truthiness. configurationIssues exposes missing authored content; unavailable encounters are not auto-cleared.

AgentAdventureEvent.description: Present during event and event_result. Options/discard previews are frozen at presentation. Continue enters a follow-up, actual event encounter, special dungeon or map. The recursion limit is shared with the overlay.

AgentAdventureTreasure.description: Present in treasure, treasure_relic and treasure_result. A relic bag is not granted until one of its revealed relics is chosen; continue is available only after the reward is applied. Options are frozen at entry; reading them never grants or rolls rewards.

AgentAdventureDungeon.description: Check active explicitly. Unity may serialize an absent optional object as a default object. Dungeon moves cost zero AP; the left exit retreats and the right exit records completion score. Entry and exit happen through ordinary event continuation and movement. Nested dungeon entry is rejected like the formal UI.

RunSettlementStats.description: Cloned formal counters including dungeon score; runStartedUnixSeconds is actual server time for this run.

AgentAdventureMeta.description: Formal ability tree read from the isolated wallet/progression services. Unlocks/toggles are legal only after the run finishes; applied by the shared bootstrap on the next run.

AgentAdventureAbility.description: state is Locked, Available or Unlocked. Enabled is the formal toggle preference; locked nodes do not grant bonuses.

AgentAdventureSettlement.description: completed indicates a finished run. shared_score uses the formal calculator/wallet service; map_abandon_no_rewards preserves formal map abandon and has no score data. Retrying a mutation does not award again. In-process guarantee; crash-safe persistence/replay is B007.

RunSettlementDisplayStats.description: Duration uses actual server UTC at create/settlement; formal short-run multiplier applies. Observe never advances the saved start time or awards points. Replay must record settlement time in B007.

AgentAdventureStartingRelic.description: starting_relic blocks movement until shared acquisition of all ability-provided starting bags. Refresh/acquisition use formal services, including OnRelicAcquired effects.

replayBacked.description: Restores a playable decision by replaying the journal; not a raw Unity scene snapshot.

progressionJson.description: Serialized isolated ability service progress, used only inside replay/save files.

create.description: Recorded create request. In inactive/default response DTOs Unity serializes an empty create object with op empty string; this is not an executable request.

AgentAdventureReplay.description: Complete accepted mutation journal, including actual operation UTC, initial isolated progress and every observation hash. Replays cannot select a persistent profile. Engine/API/content versions must match; verify after closing every active session.
